description: This header file defines the interface and class implementation for an Analytics component within a plugin architecture, including methods for sending events, configuration, internal data structures for actions and events, and threading mechanisms.

classes.name: AnalyticsImplementation
classes.description: Implements the IAnalytics and IConfiguration interfaces, handling event processing, configuration, and backend communication within a threaded environment.

methods.name: SendEvent
methods.description: Publishes an analytics event with provided parameters such as name, version, source, timestamps, and payload.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the analytics plugin using the provided shell interface.

methods.name: ActionLoop
methods.description: Main loop processing actions and events from queues.

methods.name: IsSysTimeValid
methods.description: Checks if the system time is valid.

methods.name: SendEventToBackend
methods.description: Sends an event to the backend service.

methods.name: GetCurrentTimestampInMs
methods.description: Retrieves current system timestamp in milliseconds.

methods.name: GetCurrentUptimeInMs
methods.description: Retrieves current system uptime in milliseconds.

methods.name: ConvertUptimeToTimestampInMs
methods.description: Converts system uptime duration into a timestamp in milliseconds.
